OCR Engine
Power level, preprocessing and confidence gate.
Balanced accuracy and speed for everyday documents. (auto-selected from your PC specs — override in Settings)

Grayscale, contrast & Otsu binarization

35%

Below this score, characters become "?" instead of wrong guesses.

How it works
The engine binarizes your image, segments character blobs via connected components, groups them into lines, then matches each glyph against canvas-rendered templates from 4 power tiers across 7 font families × 2 weights. Everything runs in this tab — zero network calls.

About local voices
Where each voice actually comes from.
Bundled engine
The AuraVoice formant synthesizer ships inside this app — 12 profiles, zero bytes to download, works with the network cable unplugged.
System runtime
Your OS/browser ships neural voices (Windows Natural, macOS Siri, Chrome voices). AuraVoice drives them locally — audio is synthesized on-device.
Pro packs
Marked "pro" entries describe expansion packs for the formant engine (emotion curves, context prosody). They are listed for completeness; bundled ones are always active.
